title: Montserrat scanned and found to carry a tridactyl fetus

tellings.quote: So, right now they're showing us the moment exact moment they discovered that she was pregnant when they were doing the scans because it happens live, so that's what they're showing us right now.

plain: In Peru, one of the mummified three-fingered bodies, known as Montserrat, is said to have been scanned and found to be pregnant, carrying a three-fingered fetus. Michels tells this himself from his visit, describing being shown the recording of the scan at "the exact moment they discovered that she was pregnant," which, if real, would suggest these bodies were living, reproducing beings.
